eps.o: As the team relaunches their investigation on Skinwalker Ranch, they are surrounded by a shocking phenomenon.
When the gigantic, invisible Bubble raises new questions for the team, possible answers suddenly fall from the sky.
The team ignites a massive bonfire to investigate the Bubble. But what appears in the smoke is more chilling than anyone expected.
As the team launches high-powered rockets into the sky on Skinwalker Ranch, they are frozen in shock by what they encounter.
When the team deploys a cutting edge new technology on Skinwalker Ranch to study the mysterious Bubble, it leads to an unsettling revelation.
As the team conducts an operation to mark the barrier of the massive Bubble anomaly, they make a series of shocking discoveries.
After the team unearths new and bizarre clues from the Mesa on Skinwalker Ranch, a complex laser experiment leads to an encounter.
When a stunning UAP appears above Skinwalker Walker Ranch during an experiment involving hundreds of illuminated drones, the timing of what happens next leaves the team in disbelief.
When the team flies a cutting-edge radar device high above Skinwalker Ranch, it reveals shocking new clues about the Bubble and what may be inside the Mesa.
While drilling in the Mesa on Skinwalker Ranch, the team makes a discovery that could literally be out of this world.
After lab tests reveal stunning clues about the ceramic material, the team faces a hard decision about their investigation of the Mesa.
As the team performs new scientific tests on the ceramic material found in the Mesa, they uncover evidence that something top secret may be buried on Skinwalker Ranch.
After obtaining shocking new data on the ceramics that came out of the Mesa, the team performs a final and explosively revealing experiment on the Bubble.
After an explosive experiment aimed at the mysterious Bubble, the team examines the incredible phenomena they have discovered on Skinwalker Ranch with a number of world renown experts and scientists.
